SECTOR SPEC: LIFE SUPPORT — SECTOR 2

Nominal Operating Bands

O2 saturation: 19.5-23.5%
CO2 concentration: 0-0.5%
Cabin pressure (kPa): 95-105
Hull temperature: nominal band -40 to -10 C
Humidity: 30-60%

Notes
Readings outside these bands should be cross-checked against the telemetry
translator before triggering a crisis alert.
